modeSemantics.migration: Rust is the only allowed installed-production language alongside declarative data. Python/Node/shell may remain production-reachable ONLY through an explicit time-bounded exception below; every exception names an owner packet, an expiry date, and a cutover gate. Passing in migration mode therefore still reports honest migration gaps.
modeSemantics.sealed: Zero Membrane-owned interpreter-backed production rows; only exact packaged Blueprint external-component rows listed by this policy may remain. Every cutover flag is complete, every dev-only/migration-oracle row carries a deletion-or-exclusion proof, no deleted selector reappears, and every production row has a resolved packaged value. The checker never issues a native-only seal itself; it only enumerates blockers.

notes: Inventory scope is git-tracked files; node_modules/, target/, dist build output and the untracked Hub src-tauri/runtime payload are outside the manifest by construction.
Untracked generated payloads (apps/membrane-hub/src-tauri/runtime/**) are release-qualification concerns under spec section 16.4 and must be proven at package time, not here.
